texts.title: Not Made For It
texts.body: {child.name}'s tutor has asked for a word. The child is not stupid and not idle, the tutor says carefully, but the course {self.name} set is not where {child.name}'s mind goes. Every lesson is a hill. {child.name} has started to dread the schoolroom, and to look at {self.name} as the reason for it.

choices.let_them_follow_their_bent: Let them follow their own bent.
choices.they_will_learn_it: They will learn it all the same.

texts.title: Far Ahead Of Their Years
texts.body: The tutor has run out of things to teach {child.name}. It is said without pride, almost with alarm: the child is doing work that grown students stumble over, and asking for more. People will hear of it. What matters is what {self.name} makes of it first.

choices.let_them_be_a_child: Let them be a child a while longer.
choices.give_them_the_best: Give them the best teacher there is.

texts.title: The Work Of Years
texts.body: It does not arrive as a moment. {self.name} simply notices, in the middle of an ordinary day's business, that something which used to be hard is no longer hard, and that people have begun to defer to {self.name} on it without being asked. Years went into that.
